title: hotfix: fix connection-pool goroutine leak in slo-enforcer (regional failover stability)
author: Jordan Patel
description: Background: During the recent incident on 2026-02-12 we observed the SLO enforcer in several regions fail to recover under sustained connection churn. Investigation found a goroutine/connection pool leak in the regional failover path of the SLO enforcer: when a backend connection was closed due to timeout/failover, the allocator path could leave a goroutine and connection object staged but never returned to the idle pool. Over time this reduced effective capacity and caused cascading load-shedding and failover storms.
commits: Fix: ensure conn cancellation and waiter cleanup in connpool (Jordan Patel)
Test: add unit test for connpool leak scenario (Jordan Patel)
Integration: add chaos test for regional failover path in slo-enforcer (Jordan Patel)
Docs: note new metric for leaked_conn_count (Jordan Patel)
review_comments: Ava Chen: Can you add a short note on the performance impact of the new atomic counter? We want to ensure it doesn't regress hot paths.
Jordan Patel: Response: the counter is atomic.AddInt64 on exit paths only; added a benchmark in pool_test.go demonstrating <0.2% overhead at 10k req/s.
Diego Ramos: The integration chaos test is flaky on CI (timing). Can you make the timing windows more permissive and add retry assertions?
Jordan Patel: Adjusted chaos test: increased timeouts, introduced eventual assertions and reduced false positives. Also mocked a long-hang path to reproduce locally.
Priya Nair: Approve after CI passes and we add the dashboard panel for leaked_conn_count so on-call can triage proactively.
Jordan Patel: Added dashboard JSON and release_notes entry; CI green on re-run.
merge_summary: Merged via squash on 2026-02-17 by Jordan Patel. Includes unit & integration tests, metrics and docs. Patch mitigates goroutine/connection pool leak in slo-enforcer regional failover path and adds observability to detect recurrence.
release_notes: Hotfix: Fix connection-pool goroutine leak in slo-enforcer that could lead to capacity erosion during regional failover. Adds leaked_conn_count metric and chaos integration test. Recommended: deploy to all regions with Dedicated and Private clusters as soon as possible.
